## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasChartEngineElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### enum `ChartLimiterCaptionPlacement`

Where a limiter's caption goes.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Solved` | the label solver places it near the line's far end (default) |
| `AboveEnd` | exactly above the line near its far end, never moved |
| `BeyondEnd` | Past the line's far end, outside the plot, in room the engine reserves beside it - the "UCL = 25.018" column of a control chart, clear of the data. For a line that runs across the screen (a value limiter under Vertical, a domain limiter under Horizontal); otherwise AboveEnd. |

### struct `ChartSpanAnnotation`

A dimension line between two value-space points, with an arrowhead at each end and a boxed caption at its middle (phase 3, slot 700): the lead time / cycle time / WIP spans of a cumulative flow diagram, a gap between two series, a measured interval. x maps through the axis at xAxisIndex (the projection's domain / u), y through yAxisIndex. The caption box is an obstacle in the label plan, so solved value labels steer around it.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `xAxisIndex` | `size_t xAxisIndex = 0` |  |
| `yAxisIndex` | `size_t yAxisIndex = 1` |  |
| `from` | `Point2Dd from` | value space |
| `to` | `Point2Dd to` |  |
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(120, 122, 128, 255)` |  |
| `width` | `float width = 2.4f` |  |
| `arrowSize` | `double arrowSize = 7.0` |  |
| `boxColor` | `Color boxColor = Color(235, 235, 238, 235)` |  |
| `textColor` | `Color textColor = Color(70, 72, 78, 255)` |  |
